page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 96 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system features 736.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 7.67 GB of memory per core. For parallel processing tasks, the instance is equipped with eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, providing a total of 256 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, requiring all storage to be network-attached, and supports a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a significant divergence between single-core and multi-core performance. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance is weak, scoring 1104.49 and placing in the bottom 25% of tested instances. Conversely, the multi-core CPU performance is strong, scoring 70674.73 and placing in the top 25%, reflecting the high density of the 96 dedicated physical cores. The CPU supports AVX and AVX512f instructions, but lacks newer extensions such as AVX512_VNNI and AMX.

This instance represents a high-density hardware profile with substantial GPU and memory resources. The lack of local storage is a key architectural tradeoff, necessitating external storage configurations for data-intensive operations. The hardware configuration is designed for parallel computing workloads, including deep learning training, GPU-accelerated scientific simulations, and high-performance computing tasks.
